research_method: Footage-first. Commons API live metadata and source-page verification, then exact narration storyboard. News/trend exceptions not asserted without strong dated evidence.

canada_goose_gosling_convoy.claim: Goslings peck for food soon after hatching and stay with parents.
Both parents tend young; first flight usually 7-9 weeks.

house_sparrow_two_baths.claim: House Sparrows bathe in puddles and dust, flicking water or dust over feathers.
Water and dust bathing maintain plumage; house sparrows use wing-flicking dust baths.

european_robin_singing_and_feeding.claim: Robin song and territory context; recheck if site changes.
European robins sing to advertise territory, including outside spring.

red_squirrel_branch_dining.claim: Red squirrels move through woodland branches; nuts and seeds are main foods.

rock_pigeon_flock_takeoff.claim: Rock pigeons commonly feed on the ground in urban flocks; threat-escape narration remains a general interpretation, not proof of a particular filmed trigger.

license_policy: CC BY, CC0 or public domain only; all author names and licenses verified via Commons metadata. No CC BY-SA.
visual_truth_limit: Commons first-frame thumbnails, filenames and license metadata do NOT establish that a specific movement occurs at a precise time. Hourly QA must independently inspect hook/action/payoff and actual MP4 before scheduling.
